book.name: Matyu
book.title: Matyu Matyu Re Basrasem Tuma Yenbo.

content: Now yaku nen tame sikwur sakwr tuma.
Jisas re op wem. Keryen Yen God re kwom panen site wule re gwopkap. Tame re now bukre temenem. Kerwu kwobke re yin re now yaku nente tame sopte yim.
Yin lam, re remne op wem. Kem yabel wuri yaku nente, an kemne kel wuri newote. Op wemke, rem kirkir wem, re remne now yaku werasem.
Kerwu yabelke re kwomke yin lam, rane tame rem bupo me temenem, rem yakukene bo.
Re remne op wem. Kem ari now yaku nente, an kemne tokwo yenbo newote. Op wemke, rem reri wem yaku yim.
Yabel me pebem, re kwomke sene yim. Yabel warbem, re sene yin yaku nen tame rane sene potem.
Perpe re sene yin lam, rane tame rem bupo me tetemenem. Re remne op wem. Mapurke kem bupo me tetetene?
Rem sein op wem. Nemne yike tame yaku be wuri newotene. Re op wem. Kem ari now yaku nente.

Tektebem, now mutame reri yaku lakere tame rene re op wem. Ne yaku nen tame remne wepoten tokwo newote. Tiptuwu yawo tame remne ne tokwo kiyi newote. Kiyi yawo tame remne ne tokwo tiptuwu newote. Op wem.
Tiptuwu yam tame rem kel wuri wulare wulare potem.
Yaku kiyi temnan nenem tame rem yan etop lam, rem op habom. Nem kel nugwape potte nenbo. Op habom, rem kirkir kel wuri wulare wulare potem.
Rem now mutame rene tuma kwobke op wem.

Er tame rem yuri yawo, rem yaku nugwape be nenye. Rem keraket nenye. Nem kerwuk yawo, yabel bukre nemri weske gereye, nem nugwape yaku bukre nenye. Mapurke ne nemne remne newoye tokwokap newoye? Et yaper.
Now mutame re remri tame wuri rene sein op wem. Metye. An nene yaper be nenye. An nene kiyi weye. Ne anne yaku nente, an nene kel wuri newote. An op weye, ne kirkir teye. Ari weyekap an etop newoye.
Nene newoye tokwo ne opu poten sen yi. Nene newoye tokwokap an selye, an yuri yawo tame remne etop kirkir newote.
Et ari wos. Nugwape kel et ari kel. An newote wete, kem kap wete. An yenbo nenye, an remne bupo me newoye, mapurke kem sewaibo? Re op wem.
Jisas re sene op wem. Yike tatame rem tiptuwu yam, rem sene temnas yite. Yike tatame rem kiyi temnas yam, rem tiptuwu sene yate.
Jisas re tewo murwe sene op wem. An sate, an sene wayen site.
Jisas re Jerusalem kwomke yibem, re nugwape tatame remne mesegenen reri letpeis tewo pes kere tame remne op wem.

Kem met. Gwopte nem Jerusalemke yaute. An More Tame Tem Tame, rem anne keikeren rem anne panen yite. God Reri Kwoborke yaku nenbo tame remri keryen yenkene Moses Reri Wule peikbo tamekene rem anne remne panen yite. Rem anne tuma natebon pen sate wete tetane.
Sene agerbo tame, Juda tame bo, rem anne poten anne tuma yaper wen paku pete, anne mek kwuren peikkeren an sate. Neir pes tete, murwek an sene wayen site. Jisas re op wem.
Jemskene Jonkene rep keryen yen tete wem.
Sebeti reri yen pes repri nawot te yen repne Jisas rene panen yam, te gulke pan Jisas rene wos wemetem.

Jisas re tene wemetem. Ne be wos selye? Te sein op wem. Yuri ne Keryen Yen tete, ne wolbaye bukrek site, an selye, ari yen pes rep nerenkene meknik site. Wuri re neri let giriyke site, wuri re neri let mamek site, rep nerenkene kwom panen site.

Op wemke, Jisas re tene sein op wem. Neri wemetye tuma ne heyar be mettene. Op wem, re repne wemetem. Rem anne yaper nente, an mus mette, kap kep kirkir kebese mette, o kep anne mesegente. Rep sein op wem. Yehow. Nes nene be mesegente.
Jisas re wem. Rem anne yaper nentekap, rem kepne kirkir nente. Aren, an be wete, yike ari let giriy o ari let mamek site. Et ari yaku bo. Apiy eterwou re wete, yike etek site. Jisas re op wem.
Jisas reri agerbo anepoi tame letpeis rem er tuma metemke, rem tame pes repne gwule tuma wem.
Jisas re remne wen yan op wem. Nowselri keryen yen rem remri kulke tetane tatame remne yaku bukre newobo. Rem yaku be nente, keryen yen rem remne paku pete.
Remri nenbokap, kem kap nente. Kem keryen yen tete selte, kem yaku nenbo tamekap tete.
Kem keryen yen tete selte, kem nugwape tatame remne yaku nente.

More Tame Tem Tame, re etopwou nenbo. Re yam, re be wem, tatame rem rene yaku nente. Yehow. Re remne yaku nente yam. Re tatame remne kwobo late yam. Rem rene pen sate, re remne tupan remri wule yaper poten septite. Jisas re op wem.
Jisas re le si tame pes heyarem.
Rem Jeriko kwom mesegenen yibem, nugwape tatame rem Jisas rene sumowen yim.
Yibemke, le si tame pes rep kelow kelarek simenem, rep metem, Jisas re er kelowke yabem. Etop metem, rep yaye op tem. Jisas, ne Devit eterri tame beig, ne nesne pap met.
Tatame rem repne suwayen op wem. Kep elen me te. Op wemke, rep sene nobke op tem. Jisas, ne Devit reri tame beig, ne nesne pap met. Op wem.
Jisas re repri tuma metem, re repne wemetem. Kep selye, an kepne berke nente?
Rep sene op wem. Haneyen, nes selye, nesri le ne sene heyar nente.
Jisas re repne pap metem, re repri le let keren repri le heyar tem. Rep le heyar sene lan rep rene sumowen rem etop yim.
